description: This file defines interfaces, proxy, and stub classes for IUnknown in a COM-like architecture, including reference counting, interface querying, and remote communication handling within the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: UnknownStub
classes.description: Base class for stub implementations of IUnknown, providing interface ID, conversion, and handle methods.

classes.name: UnknownStubType
classes.description: Template class extending UnknownStub, representing specific interface stubs with method handlers.

classes.name: UnknownProxy
classes.description: Proxy class managing remote interface references, reference counting, and communication for IUnknown.

classes.name: UnknownProxyType
classes.description: Template class providing interface-specific proxy functionality, including reference management and interface querying.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the size of the stub or proxy.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts incoming data to an IUnknown pointer.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles incoming messages based on index.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquires a reference to the interface, possibly creating a proxy.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and possibly destroys the proxy.

methods.name: RemoteInterface
methods.description: Retrieves a remote interface by ID.

methods.name: Interface
methods.description: Gets an interface by implementation ID and interface ID.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Creates a message for invoking a method.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method with a message.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Completes a call, handling reference release and cleanup.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the proxy.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Queries for a specific interface by ID.
